Earlier versions: Demo set, early build: the Earth Engine re-runs of 13 Oct 2026 (commit df45350), before the merge fix. Built from the files those runs saved, while Claude Code prepares the full export. Upstream of the merge it carries the open cache-grid issue (PR #42, question 1). The final re-run replaces it. Two Sanjay Van runs of 15 Oct 2026 (commit 5027a48) segment kept land only (configs/sanjay_van_*_keptland.yaml). Four Odisha box runs of 15 Oct 2026 (commit d180cb8) segment kept land only in the boxes (configs/odisha_v120_3ha_squares_*_keptland.yaml). Four more, of 15 Oct 2026 (commit da7ab30), take their radar from the descending Sentinel-1 orbit (configs/odisha_v120_3ha_squares_*_keptland_s1desc.yaml).

groups.title: Fixed after the review of 19 Oct 2026 (round 13)

items.text: Distance to water now sees water outside the mapped area too; before, it saw only the water inside it.
The Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 date windows now include their last day; before, they stopped a day early, and the images of that day were left out.
Slope and aspect now keep their decimals, and a flat cell has no direction; before, they were whole degrees, and a flat cell counted as facing north.

A stand's area is now its pixel count, and its position the mean of its pixel centres (round 14); before, Earth Engine's outlines counted some holes as area, which inflated those areas and moved those positions.
The sine and cosine of the time of peak greenness are no longer log-transformed before the stands are sorted into types.

A stand in several pieces now gets one average over all its pixels, and a stand with no data in a measurement is left out of the sorting, so it gets no type; before, each piece had its own average, and a stand could be sorted on a 0 it never measured.
Whether a measurement varies at all, and how it is scaled, now rest on exact quartiles; before, Earth Engine's approximate ones could drop a measurement that does vary.

The merge now counts a superpixel's pixels, and those with data, by one rule; before, pixels at the edge of the mapped area were counted in part, and some superpixels had more pixels with data than pixels.
The merge's size limits are now compared in whole pixels; before, a sum of two areas could be judged over a limit it exactly met.

groups.title: Changed before R3, after the same review (round 14)

items.text: The stand types are now fitted off Earth Engine on the declared scaling, with many starts, keeping the best; before, Earth Engine rescaled every measurement by its range, which undid the declared scaling, and the types rested on one start.

Only measurements skewed to the right are now log-transformed, by a rule that scales with each one's spread, and angles never; before, measurements skewed either way were logged, which made the left-skewed ones more skewed.
Average greenness is now the fitted curve's mean over the whole window; before, it was the trend line's value on the window's first day.
The elbow behind the number of types is now drawn in the fit's own space, and Jaskaran chose k from it before any of R3's field scores; before, it was drawn outside that space.

The stand layers now also give the averages of each angle's sine and cosine, from which this site reads which way a stand faces and when it is greenest; plain averages of angles mislead where they wrap round, at north or at the turn of the year.
Every tie in the merge is now broken by the regions' positions, not by the superpixels' numbers, which change from run to run.

groups.title: Fixed after the two live checks (round 14)

items.text: The merge now takes every count on the superpixels' own grid; the check stopped in the merge, which measured on another grid than the one it counted pixels on.
The check stopped when Earth Engine refused to export the elbow's saved table; each row of it now carries a fixed point, which changes no number.
